# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.1.x   | ✓         |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please report security vulnerabilities via GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/loremllc/ariadne/security/advisories/new).

We aim to respond within 48 hours and issue a fix within 14 days for critical issues.

## Disclosure Policy

We follow coordinated disclosure. Once a fix is available, we will publish a security advisory describing the vulnerability, its impact, and the fix.
